answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh quill challenge every epoch. Attestation weight is discounted when the accounts vouching for you are the ones you vouch for, and kinship in the invite graph triggers the same discount. A closed island of sock puppets scores near the floor no matter how many keys it adds, because escaping the discount requires genuine third-party verification. Net effect on the marble: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal 18b1z.
